description: This file defines the Notification class within the Opencart Admin Model for Tools. It provides methods for managing notifications such as adding, editing status, deleting, and retrieving notifications from the database.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Model class for managing system notifications in the admin panel. Handles CRUD operations on notification records.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Inserts a new notification record into the database with details provided in the data array.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (active/inactive) of a specific notification by ID.

methods.name: deleteNotification
methods.description: Deletes the notification record identified by the given ID.

methods.name: getNotification
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific notification by ID.

methods.name: getNotifications
methods.description: Fetches a list of notifications with optional filtering, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalNotifications
methods.description: Returns the total count of notifications, optionally filtered by status.
